kind: extensible persistent Python agent and workbench

runtime.execution: Python async monologue with background event-loop threads, extension middleware, local/SSH persistent PTY shells and background worker contexts.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local contexts, shells, vector memory and snapshots; consumes model/MCP/A2A/SSH/host bridge services. Local shells are agent-owned, not shared compute consumption.

summary: Broad editable extension machinery changes arguments/results/continuation around core functions; persistent terminal sessions and parallel workers coexist with nonpersistent Python subprocess actions.

inspection.scope: Read actual loop/provider/tools, implicit/explicit extension loader, code execution/PTTY lifetime, parallel/delegation/A2A, memory, history/persistence/time-travel and direct lifetime/compression test oracles.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed. Not every built-in/community plugin or host bridge traced. Extension watchdog registration function exists but startup wiring not established in inspected paths; core provider adapter internals not exhaustive.

actions.name: code_execution_tool / input / output / reset
actions.lifecycle: persistent shell, new Python/node process per code action; output timeout need not terminate command
actions.authority: model code execution plugin, local or configured SSH authority

actions.name: parallel start/background/await/cancel
actions.lifecycle: background contexts, result collection; terminal cancellation label precedes cleanup settlement

actions.name: call_subordinate / a2a_chat
actions.output: subordinate reply/context ID or remote task result
actions.lifecycle: local awaited monologue or remote wait; busy child reuse refused
actions.authority: model delegates profile/remote agent; no general local busy peer mailbox established

actions.name: Explicit/implicit extension programs
actions.input: Python files at hook/function hierarchy; mutable arguments/results
actions.lifecycle: per call; fresh local tools; cached extensions invalidated by watchdog primitive
actions.authority: ordinary extension code; host APIs broad, model can author via file/program actions

actions.name: memory save/load/delete/forget family
actions.lifecycle: standing vector DB persists; not general SQL or interpreter heap

actions.name: Time Travel snapshot/list/travel/revert
actions.lifecycle: pre-change snapshot and preserved references; file restoration only

filesystem.detail: Model terminal programs and workspace snapshots edit/read files; dedicated all-plugin file tool families not exhaustively traced.

processes.detail: Persistent numbered local/SSH PTY shells, output/input/reset and parallel lifetime handling; bounded kill settlement loses handle on final wait errors.

code_actions.detail: Model Python/node/shell programs compose ordinary computing; native hooks receive full mutable objects.

persistent_kernel.detail: Persistent shell holds cwd/process state; Python action invokes ipython -c each time, so Python variable namespace not persistent in this path.

standing_database.detail: Persisted vector documents with IDs/metadata and model similarity/filter query; scope is memory retrieval, not SQL research workbench.

workflow_programming.detail: Implicit/explicit Python hooks may short circuit/replace functions and rewrite model/tool/continuation, plus parallel job tool.

multi_model.detail: Per-call chat/utility model resolution and middleware can replace model/message programmatically; profiles/delegation retained.

live_collaboration.detail: Remote A2A conversational tasks with cached context; local child call awaited, separate busy child cannot be reused without await/cancel. No traced open local peer room.

concurrent_work.detail: Parallel tool/child background jobs and persistent multiple shells; ordinary tool loop distinct from parallel tool.

steering_interrupt.detail: Cooperative pause/interventions at stream/tool checkpoints; cancellation marks job terminal after future.cancel rather than confirmed cleanup completion.

turn_redefinition.detail: Actual mutable function-start/end and result hooks can replace prompt/model/function/continuation behavior; activation not default settled-work staging.

compaction.detail: Nested topic/bulk summarization and token-decrease/pass-budget guard; provider state clearing test checks ID retention.

context_repair.detail: History may preserve nested summary records but old bulk fallback removes; only long nonbackground results archived separately. Time Travel is workspace files, not model-context repair operation.

original_audit.detail: Logs capped1000, background excluded, tool-result extra archives only>=500; transformed/masked text and omitted runtime fields, not all original provider/program attempts.

audit_query.detail: Model can read long-result archive paths and memory retrieval; full original IO absent and file time-travel query scoped separately.

hot_change.detail: Tool classes imported from file per get_tool; prompt/model resolved per call. Cached extension invalidation primitive exists but startup watchdog wiring not established here.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Chat reconstruction excludes underscore runtime state/shell handles/background contexts; source extension loading and file travel do not implement executable/outpost refit.

remote_services.detail: SSH interactive shell and remote A2A task consumer with cached chat ID; external standing service lifecycle not governed by these client actions.

self_improvement.detail: Editable broad extension programs plus versioned file snapshots support model self-change; independent experiment/evaluate/promote governance not traced.

complaints.detail: Model notify_user gives nonterminal details/priority; automatic state capture, issue plus external complaint table not established.

authority.detail: Native code plugin dispatch runs model program and extension objects with broad access; precise all-plugin approvals/host deployment boundaries not fully studied.

evaluation.detail: Command-once/poll/cancellation-close mocks and exact stalled-compression/ID state oracles; OS termination/provider settlement not tested here.

time_order.detail: Monotonic stream cadence, wall completed-job time and ordered history; paused callbacks do not establish pauseable logical deadlines.

evidence.claim: Provider stream hooks, interventions, model-result hook may skip default processing; tool break result ends monologue.
Before/after prompt extensions rewrite system/history; latest formatted context stored separately.
Per-call model resolved and call-data/model/messages/callbacks exposed to before/after middleware.
Implicit function extension contract allows argument/result replacement, short circuit and exception replacement.
Actual async decorator executes start/original/end with mutable data.
Agent-path extension precedence and cached classes; watchdog callbacks clear class caches, startup wiring not established here.
Tool class located in profile hierarchy then freshly loaded and instantiated.
Tool module file executes via importlib spec per load.
Agent loader alias resolves to actual modules loader.
Tool before/after and argument/result extension hooks; returned break_loop determines continuation.
Terminal/Python/Node/output/reset actions; parallel workers keep polling then close shells in finally.
Persistent per-agent shell state; local/SSH connect cleanup; Python action is ipython -c subprocess, not persistent namespace.
Existing shell command/output polling; one closed-PTY retry can resubmit command; printable command masked/clipped.
TERM then KILL bounded waits and FD release-once; final wait errors suppressed before dropping process handle.
Cooperative pause at checkpoints, intervention preserves partial text and raises; does not globally suspend subprocess/provider work.
Start/background/await/cancel model tool with job IDs and wait semantics.
Calls deferred kill then immediately marks job terminal; no awaited settlement in this function.
Ordinary deferred kill cancels future without awaiting task cleanup; optional thread drain separate.
Subordinate monologue awaited and context persisted, existing context_id continuation supported.
Reusing separate subordinate while running refused; must await or cancel parallel job.
Remote task send/wait and cached provider context ID; awaited RPC, not local peer chat room.
Model standing memory similarity query with limit/threshold/filter.
Document IDs/timestamps/area and persisted vector insert/update.
Topic/bulk summaries and nested records with progress guard; old bulk fallback may remove records.
Compaction wait exits on no token reduction or max passes and logs stall.
Background contexts excluded; chat atomic write flush/file+directory fsync, later load reconstructs contexts.
Underscore runtime state excluded, history serialized and log capped1000; not live shell/parallel/provider continuation image.
Only large>=500 nonbackground tool results separately saved and file path attached.
Workspace Git snapshot/travel/revert changes files with preserved reference; not captured model context/runtime refit.
Model notification title/detail/priority/display-time, no agent-state complaint database linkage.
Mocks prove command once and poll/close rules even cancellation; followup-session jobs rejected, actual OS death not oracle.
Literal compression pass limits and retained response ID list after active state clearing.

tests.focus: side-effect single execution and owned shell cleanup
tests.oracle: Exact execute once/poll rules and close mocked on cancellation; no actual OS termination proof.
No-progress stops once, max-pass bound and response IDs preserved while active IDs removed; fake history, not summary quality oracle.

strengths: Substantial extensible function machinery with mutable args/results/exceptions.
Real ordinary terminal/SSH integration and explicit parallel result handles.
Atomic chat persistence includes file and directory fsync.
limits: Persistent shell does not make ipython -c actions a persistent Python kernel.
Cancellation status can precede cleanup, and terminal close forgets handle after suppressed final wait errors.
Selective chat/log/results omit background work and runtime state.
arconaut_questions: Give model executable turn programs with explicit version/activation semantics, beyond ad hoc callback freshness.
Keep wait timeout, cancel request and confirmed resource settlement distinct.
Separate terminal session, interpreter namespace and shared service lease contracts.
